evidence.quote:
A rollback
we have not rehearsed is a rollback we do not actually have.

observations.why: Aphoristic maxim rendering a technical mandate into plain, memorable parallel structure — a register signature distinct from the document's baseline directive voice.

mints.name: RuleAsMatchedOpposition
mints.title: crystallize a rule into matched opposed clauses
mints.frame: Is the speaker forging a maxim by mirroring two clauses against each other so the rule becomes self-evident?
